## COMPETITOR RANKING TABLE

| Handle | Followers | Avg Likes | Eng Rate | Top Content Type |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **@garvit.irl** *(Benchmark)* | **6,009** | **302.6** | **33.93%** | High-engagement DM automation / Interactive tech workflows |
| **@dhavalkataria_** | 50,480 | 9,173.3 | 18.17% | Aspirational mindset storytelling & "Comment Money" business hooks |
| **@favourite.engineer** | 155,339 | 11,544.3 | 7.43% | Prompt breakdowns ("Power of Prompt") & Free vs. Paid tool swaps |
| **@aryamanupmanyu** | 74,331 | 2,004.8 | 2.70% | Real-world AI agent teardowns (e.g., shoe commerce/automation) |
| **@nick_saraev** | 663,068 | 3,556.2 | 0.54% | Claude Code plugins, CLI tools, & automated scraping setups |
| **@arshman** | 375,278 | 1,989.9 | 0.53% | Standalone consumer AI tools (voice cloning, virtual try-on, gadgets) |
| **@vaibhavsisinty** | 2,125,297 | 8,702.5 | 0.41% | High-reach emotional/lifestyle storytelling & weekly AI news roundups |
| **@ishansharma7390** | 1,271,809 | 3,845.1 | 0.30% | Personal milestone narratives, life advice, & tech concept listicles |
| **@nivedan.ai** | 525,226 | 479.7 | 0.09% | Model release summaries & general AI industry news updates |

---

## GROWTH GAPS

1. **Broad Discovery & Tool Alternative Teardowns:**
   Competitors like `@favourite.engineer` drive massive breakout reach (33k+ likes) by packaging practical utility into simple, visually appealing listicles (e.g., *"10 paid AI tools and their FREE twins"* or *"Power of Prompt"*). `@garvit.irl` has high comment depth from core followers but lacks top-of-funnel listicle formats that trigger non-follower saves and shares.

2. **Applied "Proof-of-Work" AI Agent Demos:**
   Creators like `@aryamanupmanyu` capture high engagement (12k–27k likes) on sub-100k accounts by showing tangible, end-to-end agent builds for specific industries (e.g., ecommerce sneaker bot agent). Demonstrating full end-to-end setups creates stronger FOMO than theoretical tips.

3. **Hybrid Lifestyle / Founder Storytelling Hooks:**
   Accounts scaling past 1M+ followers (`@vaibhavsisinty` with 34k+ likes, `@ishansharma7390` with 12k+ likes) blend technical AI insights with vulnerable, relatable life lessons and career reflections. Purely technical content hits a ceiling unless balanced with personal brand equity.

---

## RECOMMENDED ACTIONS

1. **Publish a "Free Twins of Paid AI Tools" Comparison Reel (Day 1–2):**
   * *Strategy:* Replicate the high-share format of `@favourite.engineer`. Feature 5 paid enterprise AI tools paired with their open-source or free alternatives.
   * *CTA:* "Save this for your next project and comment 'FREE' to get the direct links."

2. **Deploy an End-to-End Claude/CLI Workflow Teardown (Day 3–4):**
   * *Strategy:* Emulate `@nick_saraev`'s single-keyword automation strategy by showcasing a functional Claude Code/Agent build solving a real problem (e.g., web scraping or data enrichment).
   * *CTA:* "Comment 'AGENT' to get the exact code prompt & setup template."

3. **Test a Personal Milestone / Lesson-Learned Founder Narrative (Day 6–7):**
   * *Strategy:* Follow the playbook of `@dhavalkataria_` and `@ishansharma7390`. Pair a personal realization or career journey clip with an overlay hook about building in the AI era to widen top-of-funnel reach beyond technical developers.
